metadata.description: Local-first tools that put you and your AI in charge of your own accounts and data.

plugins.name: skillbooks
plugins.description: Put an editor between your AI and the send button: cold-read a draft before you send, edit to Economist style, strip AI-writing tells, quote-check a claim, keep a durable worklog, render markdown to PDF.

plugins.name: magazines
plugins.description: Let Claude use the web signed in as you: skills drive your own logged-in browser and site APIs for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, travel and award search, plus build-dossier, find-person, and serpapi research commands.

plugins.name: holotapes
plugins.description: Slash commands for document management, mail, and office workflows.
